## About

I'm an AI engineer focused on the distance between a working prototype and a dependable product. My work spans multi-agent architectures, retrieval pipelines, fine-tuned models and the deployment work that makes them usable. I work across generative and agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, custom LLMs and vision-language applications, with the MLOps needed to keep them observable and reliable.
